name: sidereus-bugfix
title: 버그 수정 — Sidereus viewer
use: One owner-reported screen or behaviour defect in the Sidereus viewer: diagnose, minimal fix, verify, ship.
rules:
Repo: this repository (the folder holding AGENTS.md). AGENTS.md rules override this prompt.
NEVER restart the viewer, NEVER commit/stash/checkout/reset/add, NEVER run screen_check --update. The orchestrator does those.
One defect per run: anything else you find goes in findings, not in the fix.
NEVER press a real send/confirm button on the live viewer (8799); stub fetch for any write path.

stages.title: 진단
stages.task: Read-only. Reproduce the reported defect from code and data (the live page read-only, or a demo/fixture). ⚠Confirm the cause of the symptom before naming a fix: reported symptoms often have a different cause. Put in summary: the causal chain with file:line, the minimal fix point (file + function) and the regression test to add. FAIL if the cause is not proven. Change nothing.

stages.title: 수정
stages.task: Apply the minimal fix at the diagnosed point and add a regression test that fails before and passes after. ⚠Tests with a fixed functions list (FNS) must include every new helper you add. Report changed files; anything outside the fix goes in findings.

stages.title: 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report each failing step as a finding with file/line. A screen-regression diff that matches the intended fix is cause "intended" in summary, not a failure. Do not fix anything.

stages.title: 라이브 검증
stages.task: Show the reported symptom is gone on the live page with one piece of evidence (screen crop or measured value + width). ⚠Never press a real send button: stub fetch before exercising any write path.
